claims.claim: Walking Liberty half dollars designed by Adolph A. Weinman were made from 1916 through 1947; Franklin replaced Liberty in 1948.
The U.S. Mint launched the American Eagle coin program in 1986; Silver Eagles use Weinman's 1916 Walking Liberty half dollar design on the obverse.
claims.source: U.S. Mint: American Eagle Coin Program

claims.claim: The Mint refreshed the Silver Eagle reverse design in 2021.
claims.source: U.S. Mint: American Eagle Silver Proof Coin
